name: ASAM
description: Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization optimizer with optional closure-based two-pass updates.

examples.title: Optimize parameters with ASAM
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.asam import asam

parameter = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(2.0))
optimizer = asam([parameter], lr=0.05)
optimizer.zero_grad()
parameter.square().backward()
optimizer.step()

papers.title: ASAM: Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Scale-Invariant Learning of Deep Neural Networks
